steps.en: The system sends the offender's ID to the appeals system
steps.id: Sistem mengirim ID offender ke sistem appeal
steps.why_en: Only the appeals system can ask this system for data; this system never sends IDs to it.
steps.why_id: Hanya sistem appeal yang bisa meminta data ke sistem ini; sistem ini tidak pernah mengirim ID ke sana.

steps.en: The system receives the ID's appeals for a given period
steps.id: Sistem menerima appeal milik ID untuk periode tertentu
steps.why_en: No receiver or storage for appeal details exists.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada penerima atau penyimpanan detail appeal.

steps.en: The system spots another address given in an appeal
steps.id: Sistem menemukan alamat lain yang diberikan di appeal
steps.why_en: No appeal address is available to evaluate.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada alamat dari appeal yang bisa dinilai.
